text.en: Naga’s tourism directory lists RPMiranda Pili Nuts Pasalubong at 71-B Panelo Building, Elias Angeles Street, Barangay Dinaga.
A 2024 pasalubong guide describes its roasted, salted and honey-glazed pili nuts, alongside crispy pili honey.
The same guide lists pili and yema tarts, bonbon, polvoron and turones de pili, plus coco jam with pili nuts.
The city directory also lists puto seko, banana chips and sampaloc candy among its delicacies.
